meta.name: render-multiworld
meta.description: Assemble a silent, music-led 3-world product-tour ad — trim and hard-cut-concat the per-world WIDE-arrival + top-down-macro clips, composite the HTML/Playwright brand end card ("FIND YOUR DAILY." + handwritten scent labels + arrows) over an AI flat-lay background, and mux one music bed into a 720x1280 web master. FREE, deterministic assembly (Playwright + PIL/HTML + FFmpeg); the recipe supplies the config and gates the paid clip/background/music calls. Use for the multiworld-product-tour format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将多段产品视频自动合成为带音乐的品牌广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作多产品场景的短视频广告
copy.tagline_en: Assemble multi-world product clips into a branded ad with music
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create short video ads for multiple product scenes

howto.what: 这个技能会组装一段约27秒的无声广告视频，展示三种不同场景的产品，最后以品牌卡片结束。它自动裁剪和拼接视频片段，添加音乐，并生成最终视频。
howto.when: 当你需要制作一个展示三种不同场景产品的无声广告视频时触发。通常用于产品巡览格式。

say.text: 帮我制作一个三世界产品巡览广告。
say.note: 触发技能开始组装视频。

say.text: 为我的香水系列生成一个无声广告视频。
say.note: 指定产品类型，技能会处理场景和卡片。

howto.what_en: This skill assembles a silent, music-led ~27s ad video showcasing three different product scenes, ending with a brand end card. It automatically trims and concatenates clips, adds music, and produces the final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a silent ad video showcasing three different product scenes, typically for a multiworld product tour format.

say_en.text: Create a three-world product tour ad for me.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to start assembling the video.

say_en.text: Generate a silent ad video for my perfume line.
say_en.note: Specifies product type; skill handles scenes and end card.
